text:
alex: Quick mid-shift check — alpha pool at ~78% GPU util, burst headroom showing ~22%. No active preemptions.

maria: thanks alex. any noisy customers in the queue? :eyes:

alex: a few small spikes from acct-zen during onboarding tests, nothing sustained. ETA to dip below 70% is ~30-40m if trend holds.

dev_oncall_bot: Capacity snapshot (automated): pool=alpha, util=78%, burst_limit=85%, queued_requests=12, avg_latency=65ms. grafana: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/alpha_pool

jyoti: i'll hang for the next 30 to cover. if it crosses 84% we should shift some traffic to beta or enable burst-add for dedicated tenants.

samir: can someone check if any scheduled batch jobs land in the next hour? I saw one cron in sandbox that recently changed.

maria: running quick query — looks like sandbox-batch-run at 19:00 UTC, not high priority. I'll patch its retry window to off-peak and ping the owner.

alex: small note — autoscaler shows conservative backoff for alpha because of recent preemptions. if we need immediate headroom, we can trigger a manual scale: `redwoodctl pool scale alpha --nodes +2` (opt for burst nodes only)

jyoti: +1 on manual scale if util hits 82% and queue >20. I'll be online to do the swap.

samir: offering to swap shifts — I can cover the 20:00-22:00 UTC window if someone needs to log off early.

maria: thanks! if samir takes 20-22, i'll take 22-23 to overlap with night. alex — want to hand off at 19:50?

alex: handing off @maria @samir at 19:50 UTC. I'll leave the scaling playbook in #eng-oncall pinned and add the manual scale command in the thread. :thumbsup:

dev_oncall_bot: Reminder: non-urgent maintenance window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. No impact expected.

jyoti: quick FYI — keep an eye on beta pool logs for redis timeouts if we shift traffic; last time we saw a minor error burst after failover.

maria: noted. i'll enable extra logging for 30m post-shift and watch the error rate dashboard.

samir: thanks all — i'll confirm swap closer to 19:40. ping here if anything changes. :hand:

alex: done. leaving a short checklist: 1) confirm queued <15 before handoff; 2) check autoscaler bump history; 3) verify no high-priority cron in next 60m; 4) leave scale command copy. Good handoff.
